lede: The Mountain Village Town Council meets October 15 for second reading of an ordinance that changes how MVHA housing fees are set — shifting from hardcoded figures in the Municipal Code to an annual fee schedule — and will also vote on adopting the actual 2027 fee schedules for Village Court and beyond, which makes this one worth watching if you care about workforce housing costs in the region. Ouray County commissioners are meanwhile voting on opting into Proposition 123's next affordable housing commitment cycle and approving a new law enforcement intergovernmental agreement, while Telluride's Town Council spends three hours on the 2027 budget — enterprise funds, open space, and housing programs all on the table. The Telluride Horror Show rolls in Friday through Sunday, and there's a Ballot Measure 5A information meeting Monday at KOTO.
